This new repository is called lucid evolution as stated in the proposal.

In the second report we showcase the successful test execution of our test cases which run both on the preview and preprod networks at all times with each library update. 
This can be verified easily by visiting https://github.com/Anastasia-Labs/lucid-evolution/commits/main/ and checking the build status of new commits or personally running the tests by cloning the repository. Alternatively the report contains a video and a gif showcasing the successful runs.
